'''The Workstation standard config''' defines which plugins the workstation
service of the stack (the [[Workstation Compat Layer|workstation]] service, which
is dsh) activates out of the box, which rows are deliberately disabled, and which
overrides the user repo applies.

== Overview ==

The service boots the shipped '''web profile'''; the standard set is the
'''base bundle + web app bundle''', and the user-repo overlay adds the
workstation rows. Row ids are read from the bundles, not re-derived.

{{OmniFact
|what=base bundle + web app bundle + workstation overlay
|where=the workstation service bootstrap
|status=active
|source=Projects/Omniagent/Workstation-Standard-Config.md
}}

== What is active out of the box ==

The service starts with:

<pre>
node /harness/apps/cli/lib/bin.js --profile web --patch "$WORKSTATION_CONFIG_FILE" --no-open --port 0
</pre>

The '''base''' bundle carries 92 rows, including <code>tool-plugin-manager</code>,
<code>timer</code>, <code>llm</code>, <code>session</code>, <code>agent</code>,
<code>jobs</code>, <code>credentials</code>, <code>subprocess</code>,
<code>sandbox</code>, <code>tool-bash</code>, <code>tool-fs</code>,
<code>tool-fs-search</code>, <code>skill</code>, <code>subagent</code>,
<code>ptc-runtime</code>, <code>workflow-ptc</code>, <code>tool-web</code> and
<code>agent-loop</code>. The '''headless''' bundle adds 5 rows and is the one-shot
runner a worker profile composes on top of base.

The '''user-repo overlay''' (the workstation rows) adds the capability plane:
<code>http-surface</code>, <code>general-service-impl</code>,
<code>shell-impl</code>, <code>docker-impl</code>, <code>capabilities-impl</code>,
<code>himalaya-impl</code>, <code>email-himalaya</code>, <code>sms-twilio</code>,
<code>totp-rfc6238</code>, <code>email-tools</code>, <code>sms-tools</code>,
<code>totp-tools</code>, <code>browser-use-impl</code>,
<code>browser-use-playwright</code>, <code>browser-use-tools</code>,
<code>web-search-tools</code> and <code>web-session</code>.

== Deliberately disabled (and why) ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Row !! State !! Rationale
|-
| <code>hmr</code> || off || host-only reload; a server or one-shot boot has no host to reload
|-
| <code>tool-ralph</code> || off || fresh-agent iteration loop, human-gated
|-
| <code>config-editor</code>, <code>plugin-manager</code> || off without profile context || gated on the interactive profile context
|-
| <code>skill-badge</code> || off || presentation only
|-
| <code>session-query-sqlite</code> || search off || keeps no SQLite full-text index
|-
| <code>session-telemetry-otel</code> || feedback-only || the process opts out with <code>DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED</code>
|-
| <code>web</code>, <code>web-fetch-http</code>, <code>tool-web</code> || disabled by the web app bundle || the Web UI composes search and fetch per agent preset
|}

== Deliberate decisions ==

* '''D1''' - web search is not provisioned: the capability consumer resolves the
  <code>web-search@1</code> service at call time, and the health probe answers
  <code>missing-service</code> until a provider row exists.
* '''D2''' - credentials are names, never values: <code>DEEPSEEK_API_KEY</code>
  and the other references are resolved at call time by the credentials service;
  see [[Secrets Store]].
* '''D3''' - the facade is the capability plane, the worker run is the agent
  plane. The harness agent tool family is NOT reachable through the facade.
* '''D4''' - the worker sandbox is a role decision; each role ships a dsh profile
  patch with the sandbox, approval and permission rows.
* '''D5''' - the email wiring needs the omni-root checkout inside the
  <code>workstation-tools</code> container, so that service binds
  <code>/opt/omni</code> read-only (see [[Container Mount Map]]).

== Effective surface ==

<pre>
GET /health   {"status":"ok","service":"workstation","uptime_s":1136,"tools":15}
GET /api/tools {"status":"ok","tools":["sms numbers","sms list","sms get","sms code",
  "totp list","totp code","email accounts","email list","email get","email code",
  "email send","browser","web search","web search providers","session"]}
</pre>

The capability families are email, sms, totp, browser and web. The harness agent
tools are reached by a '''worker profile''', not by the facade.

== Open gaps ==

# No agent-run entry on the facade.
# Dev agent wiring: the remote plugin reports <code>not_found</code> in the dev stack.
# A <code>web-search@1</code> provider is missing.
# The model credential is not provisioned in the dev store.
# <code>HIMALAYA_HERMES_PASSWORD</code> is not provisioned in the dev store.
